Cape tunic blue

Internal ID: ArmorTunic2 | Type: Body | Source: Hildir | Buy: 450, Coins | Armor: 1 | Base Item Stamina Usage: -20%

Introduction. Cape tunic blue is an armor piece which can be purchased from Hildir for 450 Coins. This item will be in the merchant's assortment only after returning Hildir's silver chest.

Notes. • Wearing this armor decreases stamina usage while using the Hammer, the Hoe, the Cultivator, and the Serving tray by 20%.
